subject: Mid-year checkpoint: Rohan Mehta — manager notes & calibration
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, PeopleOps Intake <peopleops@northlane.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-year checkpoint: Rohan Mehta — manager notes & calibration

Hi team,

Following up on our 1:1s — I put together a short draft of manager notes for Rohan's mid-year checkpoint and want to align before we push anything to PeopleOps. Key points:
- Strengths: system design ownership, reducing inference latency across two products.
- Areas to document: cross-team communication gaps, missed timelines in Q1 infra migration.
- Calibration ask: split between "meets expectations" and a narrow "exceeds" case for IC4 promotion consideration.

I've attached a very rough draft (rohan_manager_notes_draft.docx) and a CSV with my preliminary scores. Can each of you:
1) Add any evidence bullets (deliverables, dates, metrics) inline in the doc;
2) Confirm the score band you feel is appropriate (we'll use the manager_scores_q2.csv as the canonical source);
3) Call out anything that would block a promoted title change on a 6/1 timeline so PeopleOps can prep the packet.

Prefer replies by EOD Monday so Sonia at PeopleOps has time to assemble the formal packet. If you think we need to route to a calibration council, say so.

Thanks,

--
Aditya Rao
Staff Engineer, Inference Serving
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rohan_manager_notes_draft.docx, manager_scores_q2.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, PeopleOps Intake <peopleops@northlane.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-year checkpoint: Rohan Mehta — manager notes & calibration

On Fri, 30 Apr 2027 at 09:03, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Following up on our 1:1s — I put together a short draft of manager notes for Rohan's mid-year checkpoint and want to align before we push anything to PeopleOps.

Thanks for kicking this off, Aditya. I added a short section to the doc with product impact bullets and dates (feature rollout: predictive caching, reduced p50 latency by ~18% between 2027-02-10 and 2027-03-20). I also suggested wording to frame the communication gaps as "coordination overhead" to avoid implying intent.

My leaning: band toward "meets expectations" for base performance, but recommend an accelerated career conversation — i.e., eligibility for a promotion this cycle if mentoring/communication improvements are visible by the July check. If you both agree, I'll flag "promotion packet recommended, contingent" when we submit to PeopleOps so they can prep the template packet but hold final approval.

I've attached a short promotion packet template with required evidence fields (promotion_packet_template.pdf). Also added suggested manager_scores in the CSV:
- Technical execution: 4/5
- Cross-team influence: 3/5
- Ownership & autonomy: 4/5
- Customer impact: 3/5

If Vivek wants to weigh in on the influence score I can soften wording.

Marissa
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachments: promotion_packet_template.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-year checkpoint: Rohan Mehta — manager notes & calibration

Agree with the approach. Quick clarifications:
- I think technical execution should be a firm 4/5 given the latency work and the pre-warm cache prototype (Q1 deliverable).
- Influence at 3/5 feels right but we should list two concrete instances where Rohan tried to drive alignment and the outcome (one success, one that stalled).
- If PeopleOps wants to accelerate, we need at least two manager+peer notes signed off; I can add mine to the doc by Monday.

Also, small ask: please do not include escalation language in the public manager note — keep the sensitive phrasing in the private "manager-only" section. I've copied Laura to confirm PeopleOps' preferences on evidence redaction.

Vivek
VP, Engineering

On Fri, 30 Apr 2027 at 10:21, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> I added a short section to the doc with product impact bullets and dates...

From: Sonia Patel <sonia@peopleops.northlane.com>
To: PeopleOps Intake <peopleops@northlane.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-year checkpoint: Rohan Mehta — manager notes & calibration

Thanks for the heads-up and for sharing the draft materials. A couple of notes from PeopleOps:
1) Evidence: we need two dated artifacts (code PRs, design docs, or customer emails) and one peer manager note to consider any promotion packet for the 6/1 timeline.
2) Redaction: confirm which paragraphs are "manager-only" so we can exclude them from any employee-facing summary.
3) Doc flow: please upload the finalized manager-only and manager-facing docs to the shared review folder (link below). We'll open HR-2027-1839 and attach the packet template; expect back-channel questions if anything is missing.

I'll create the initial ticket and flag for expedited review if you confirm the evidence set by EOD Monday.

Link to shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xk-review-rohan-2027
HR ticket: https://hr.redwood.com/tickets/HR-2027-1839

Best,
Sonia Patel
Senior People Partner
Northlane PeopleOps (outsourced partner)

Requested attachments: rohan_manager_notes_draft.docx (finalized), manager_scores_q2.csv, promotion_packet_template.pdf
